description.text: Grants [Attach Lightning with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Ashe], [Apex Heaven's Wrath Damage Tracker] and [Apex Heaven's Wrath Level]

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Ashe
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Heaven's Wrath (0~2), removed after using Apex Heaven's Wrath two times

description.name: Apex Heaven's Wrath Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Heaven's Wrath level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Ashe]

description.name: Apex Heaven's Wrath Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Heaven's Wrath level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Ashe]
